text: i think the one thing i will say is if we are doing pages though on this display do not give me it inside of a scroll container i dont want to have to scroll down just to see one more row that feels like a ton of work for no reward. show me the whole page all at once
resolution: Removed the ScrollView around the prop browser's paged grid so the whole page is visible at once (no scrolling for a stray last row). The grid measures its own area via onLayout and perPage is computed from the columns x rows of 92x84+label cells that actually fit, so each page fills the grid exactly and the prev/next pager stays pinned below. overflow:hidden guards the rare full-width 'related' divider row. Hot-reloads in rjit dev; bundle verified.
